about_the_game:
Core Setting

Sun Wukong sacrificed himself in rebellion against the Heavenly Court, and his six spiritual roots scattered across heaven and earth, transforming into shackles that suppress the Three Realms. Five hundred years later, the Heavenly Court launched a purge of the former Journey to the West disciples under the pretext of "unrepentant demonic hearts." Pig Bajie, the sole survivor, escaped the Celestial Prison bearing the label of traitor. He must retrace the old Journey to the West path, rally former allies, and gather scattered divine weapons and artifacts to uncover the truth behind Wukong’s death and ignite a rebellion that will shake the Three Realms.

The game begins with the prologue of Sun Wukong’s fall: the Heavenly Court crushes Mount Huaguo with thunderous force, slaying Sha Wujing and imprisoning Tang Sanzang. Pig Bajie is mocked by his peers for perceived cowardice and love of life, but he accidentally receives guidance from a faint remnant of Wukong’s spiritual consciousness, becoming the spark of resistance.

As players retrace the Journey to the West path, they will explore familiar locations reconstructed and twisted by the Heavenly Court.

《Pig UP》 is a unique platformer where players control Pig Bajie, ascending through epic-scale environments in a relentless climb toward the summit.

Game Features:

  • Save System: A progressive save mechanism ensures you never have to start over from scratch.

  • Graphics: Breathtaking, mythic environments inspired by Chinese legend.

  • Optimization: Smooth gameplay even on lower-end devices.

  • Rich Narrative: A reimagined tale rooted in Chinese mythology, offering a fresh and immersive story experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400, AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650, 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 570, 4 GB or Intel Arc A750, 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: no
  • VR Support: no
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K or AMD Ryzen 5 7600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 TI, 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT, 16 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Sound Card: no
  • VR Support: no
